# TheTaxCalc

> Free 2026 tax calculators for US taxpayers. 91 calculators covering all 50 states. No sign-up required.

TheTaxCalc provides free, accurate tax calculators for federal, state, and local taxes. All calculations are based on 2026 IRS tax brackets and state tax rates. Maintained by the TheTaxCalc Editorial Team — every rate verified against IRS publications and state revenue departments.

## Calculators

- [Paycheck Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/paycheck-calculator): Take-home pay after federal, FICA, and state taxes. All 50 states, 401(k)/HSA deductions.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/mortgage-calculator): Monthly payment, amortization schedule, and extra payment savings.
- [401(k) Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/401k-retirement-calculator): Projected balance with employer match and compound growth.
- [Relocation Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/relocation-calculator): Compare equivalent salary between states.
- [Capital Gains Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/capital-gains-calculator): Short-term and long-term capital gains rates (0%/15%/20% + 3.8% NIIT).
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/self-employment-tax-calculator): 15.3% SE tax on 92.35% of net income, half deduction, quarterly estimates.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/sales-tax-calculator): Combined state + local sales tax for any US state, with reverse calculator and car sales tax. Includes a dedicated page for each of the 50 states.
- [Tax Refund Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/tax-refund-calculator): Estimate your federal and state tax refund.
- [Overtime Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/overtime-tax-calculator): Savings under the 2025–2028 overtime tax exemption law.
- [Lottery Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/lottery-tax-calculator): How much tax on lottery winnings? Federal + state, lump sum vs annuity.
- [IRS Withholding Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/irs-withholding-calculator): W-4 optimization. Recommended federal withholding per paycheck.
- [Property Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/property-tax-calculator): Compare property taxes across all 50 states by home value.
- [Bonus Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/bonus-tax-calculator): How much tax on your bonus? 22% flat rate vs aggregate method.
- [Employee Cost Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/employee-cost-calculator): True cost of hiring — salary + employer FICA, FUTA, SUTA, benefits.
- [New York City Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/new-york-city-tax-calculator): NYC resident income tax (3.078%–3.876%) on top of NY state tax.
- [Los Angeles Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/los-angeles-tax-calculator): California take-home pay for LA residents, including SDI.
- [Chicago Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/chicago-tax-calculator): Illinois flat tax take-home pay for Chicago residents.
- [Home Sale Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/home-sale-tax-calculator): Capital gains on home sales with the $250K/$500K exclusion.
- [Salary Comparison Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/salary-comparison-calculator): Compare after-tax pay by state.
- [Job Offer Comparison Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/job-offer-comparison-calculator): Compare two or more job offers after taxes.
- [Paycheck Difference Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/paycheck-difference-calculator): Compare take-home pay between two states.
- [OBBBA Tax Calculator](https://thetaxcalc.com/obbba-tax-calculator): One Big Beautiful Bill Act 2025: $6,000 senior deduction, new brackets, SALT cap.
